name: TA Instruments HR20
description: A multi-purpose hybrid rheometer for advanced material characterization including shear and normal force control, oscillatory and steady flow tests
specs: Minimum torque: 1 mN·m (oscillatory) and ~3 mN·m (steady shear)
Frequency range: 1 x 10⁻⁷ Hz up to ~100 Hz
Force range: -50 N to +50 N sensitivity ~0.005 N in advertised setups
Versatile sample handling: liquids, soft solids, solids

name: TA Instruments TGA-55
description: A research-grade thermogravimetric analyzer for precise mass-change measurements as a function of temperature and atmosphere.
specs: Ambient to ~400 °C temperature range
Sensitivity: mass change detection down to 0.01 µg
Core balance: TA-Instruments Tru-Mass™ system

name: Linari Nanotech All-in-One
description: A modular electrospinning system designed for the production of nanofibers, scaffolds and coatings.
specs: Generator voltage range: 0 to 40 kV DC and 0 to -40 kV DC
Plate or drum collectors for aligned or random fibre mats
Syringe pump with flow rates from 0.1 to 50 ml/h

name: Voltera NOVA
description: A materials-dispensing platform for prototyping flexible hybrid electronics (FHE).
capabilities: works with flexible, stretchable, conformable and rigid substrates
specs: Print area: 220 x 300 mm
Trace width capability: down to ~100 µm
Substrate compatibility: rigid (FR1/FR4, silicon wafers) and flexible/stretchable/biocompatible materials

name: Voltera V-One
description: Desktop direct-write dispensing system for prototyping printed circuit boards: prints conductive ink traces, drills vias/holes, dispenses solder paste and reflows components on a heated bed.
specs: Minimum trace width 0.2 mm
Print area (W x D x H) 128 x 116 x 3 mm
XYZ resolution ~10 µm x 10 µm x 1 µm
Max heated bed temperature 240 °C

name: Formlabs Form 4B
description: A high-performance SLA 3D printer built for medical applications offering biocompatible and sterilizable materials with precision and reliability.
specs: Build volume: 200 x 125 x 210 mm
XY resolution: ~50 µm pixel size
Layer thickness: 25-300 µm
Print speed: up to ~80 mm/h
